summary: Israeli airstrikes in Gaza killed Hamas commander Maher Walid Omar al-Husseini, who participated in the October 7 Re'im base attack. sections.threat_assessment: Cross-border tensions remain high with active aerial defense responses in Lebanon and Iran. Hamas continues to pose a residual threat in Gaza despite targeted eliminations. Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia indicate ongoing regional proxy conflicts. Iranian military drills suggest sustained readiness posturing.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia has enhanced its air defense posture following Houthi strikes, intercepting multiple projectiles. Israel continues targeted operations in Gaza to degrade Hamas capabilities. The UN has reaffirmed support for Saudi Arabia's right to self-defense. Regional actors are maintaining heightened military alertness.
